Transaction.description: A GSH Flats 2018 transaction. Wire property names follow the documented API example; the data dictionary provides field meanings and declared types. Its numeric fields are documented as numeric, while the example encodes these values as strings, so both representations are allowed.

asp_sign_date.description: Date of Agreement for Sale and Purchase (ASP). Data dictionary format is dd-mm-yyyy; the example representation is 01/02/2019, which uses slashes and does not match that stated format.

block_name.description: Block name of the purchased flat.

court_name.description: Court name of the purchased flat.

flat_num.description: Flat number of the purchased flat.

floor_num.description: Floor number of the purchased flat.

sale_price.description: Sale price of the purchased flat. The data dictionary declares a numeric value (precision pattern shown as 999999999999999.99); the documented example encodes it as a string.

saleable_area.description: Saleable area of the purchased flat in square meters. The data dictionary declares a numeric value (precision pattern shown as 9999999.999); the documented example encodes it as a string.

scheme_type.description: Subsidised home ownership scheme type. The data dictionary lists GSH as a possible value.

TransactionsResponse.description: The documented response contains a data array. The source does not state whether this example exhausts all response properties or whether all transaction fields are always present.

info.description: API for transaction data for Green Form Subsidised Home Ownership Scheme (GSH) Flats 2018. The source documentation is version 2.0 dated 25 July 2024. It states that authentication is not required and that responses may be JSON, CSV, or XML. The documented example and data dictionary describe JSON. The document’s sample is malformed and inconsistently laid out; the JSON response schema below reflects the documented data fields, while the example is not presented as authoritative verbatim JSON.
info.title: Transactions in the Sale of GSH Flats 2018

get.description: Returns sales transaction data for the specified resource and language. The Simplified Chinese documentation states that this dataset does not provide Simplified Chinese data and returns Traditional Chinese instead.

parameters.description: Response language: English or Traditional Chinese.
parameters.name: lang
